title: Illustration Principles
slide_intent: Set criteria for selecting an illustration. A reader can compare its complexity, tone and energy with the role the image needs to play.
strategic_value: Instacart can reserve pictures of actual food for photography and use illustration to make an abstract idea approachable.
demonstration: A short explanation at left leads into parallel lists: approved traits in green and counterexamples in red. Effortless is paired with complex, witty with literal, lively with static and delightful with didactic.
practical_value: Use the paired words during review to name why a concept needs simplification, a more surprising subject or a clearer sense of action.

content_islands.name: Illustration remit
content_islands.spec: Set the section heading and food-first explanation in a narrow column at left.

content_islands.name: Trait comparison
content_islands.spec: Place a green check above the preferred column and a red cross above the other. Align each pair horizontally at the same size and spacing.
